name: A22
author: A22
description: FM-first custom firmware for the M-VAVE FM-1 with 4-color vector graphics, 10 flagship synth & drum engines (FM-4, Electric, Stack, Analog, Shaper, Wire, Haze, Mono, Kit, Perc), 8 selectable FX, 4-track virtual tape, mixer, and Riff/Shake sequencers.
credits: A22 is derived from h1 by Jake Handy, built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita, Hügelton Instruments.
